review_response_tasks.rationale: For the past three years说明从过去延续至今，has run适合累计期间。ran一般过去未表达延续至今；will run未来与过去三年不符；is running现在进行不能承接本句for the past three years的完成期间。
空后是单数可数名词，结合其开头音素使用a。an与该词的开头音素不合；a few和many要求复数名词，不能直接接本题的单数名词。
speaker是被询问许可者，需被动is asked。asks会变为speaker询问别人，缺其宾语且与许可流程方向不合；has asking结构错误；asking非限定谓语。
先行词a woman在定语从句作worked的主语，用who。which指物；whose需接名词；what不能在该有先行词结构中替代who。
two后为复数photos。photo单数，photoes拼写不合常规复数，photo’s为单数所有格而非两张照片。
expected immediate approval与实际要求改日期构成转折，but对应。because改日期不是预期立即同意的原因；so会错误地把改日期写作预期同意的结果；or表示选择关系不合已经发生的两件事。
thank someone for后接名词或动名词，giving正确。give/gave限定形式不作for宾语；to give不定式不直接跟该介词for。
several recordings是被播放分享，next week限定未来，will be shared。will share主动主语方向不合录音被分享；sharing缺限定助动词；have sharing结构错误。
前面直接引语Can you...?为是非问，改为间接引语由whether引导。that不能引此是非疑问；what在完整句中无名词成分空位；how改为方式问，改变了原来Can you...?的问题含义。
becoming后用形容词，than提示比较级easier。easy无比较级；easiest最高级；easily副词不能作此表语。

completed_passage:
For the past three years, our neighbourhood library has run a project called Local Voices. Residents record short memories of everyday life. The purpose is not to decide whose memory is the most important. It is to give younger people a chance to hear how the area has changed.

Before an interview begins, the speaker is asked whether the recording may be shared publicly. Without permission, it stays in a private folder. Last month, I interviewed a woman who once worked at the old railway station. She brought two photos showing the station before the new road was built. I recorded her story and sent a copy back to her.

I expected her to approve it immediately, but she asked me to change one date. I checked the notes with her instead of guessing. She thanked me for giving her that chance. A memory can be valuable even when a detail needs checking.

Next week, several recordings will be shared at a meeting for local families. “Can you bring your own headphones?” the librarian asked. In other words, she asked whether we could bring our own headphones. We replied that we could. With clear labels and careful permission records, the collection is becoming easier to use than it was at the start. The project still has much to improve, especially when different people remember an event differently.
